name: The Race for Ancient Egypt in Colour
summary:
The Race for Ancient Egypt in Colour reveals the extraordinary story of Egypt in the years between the World Wars – a time when archaeology became entangled in the politics of a nation striving for sovereignty.  In 1922, Egyptology burst onto the world stage with Howard Carter's discovery of Tutankhamun's tomb sparking global Egyptomania.  But the discovery came amid a period of rapid political change, with Egypt having won partial independence from Britain.  As its leaders sought greater control over foreign excavations, many Western archaeologists resisted, unwilling to relinquish access to a past, and despite the crucial Egyptian contributions that went largely unrecognised, the race for ancient Egypt was on!

The series also addresses other key discoveries made during this era such as Queen Hetepheres' tomb, and Pierre Montet's spectacular yet little-know discovery at Tanis – until World War II brought this golden age of discovery in Egypt to an end.

name: Vincenzo Malinconico, avvocato d'insuccesso
summary: Semi-unemployed, semi-divorced, semi-happy, but above all an unsuccessful lawyer. More psychologist than lawyer, Vincenzo Malinconico always has an off-topic thought in his head. He mostly defends friends and relatives in not particularly demanding disputes that he doesn't always win. Separated, with two children, women like him due to his insecurity, but he is unable to fulfill himself on a sentimental level. Vincenzo Malinconico makes us passionate about his ramshackle events and shows the world through his ironic and authentic gaze.

name: Rex - Vienna Calling
summary: The crime-fighting canine joins his partner, Detective Max Steiner, to solve even the hardest cases in the Austrian capital.

name: Le Rêve français
summary: In the 60s, the Government encourages Islanders to leave the French West Indies to escape poverty that results from the closure of sugar mills. Lured by the idea of a "dream country", they find life in Europe is not what they had imagined.

name: This Tastes Funny
summary: Iliza Shlesinger and her chef husband Noah Galuten travel the length of New Zealand discovering all of the sights, tastes and smells the country has to offer in preparation for Iliza's first New Zealand comedy show.

name: Ready Vet Go: The Vet Paramedics
summary: Vet paramedics race to save critically ill pets at home and on the road. Join Melbourne's vet paramedics for real pet emergencies.

name: Unacceptable
summary:
Unacceptable features Ed Gamble as host with two teams of comics battling to convince a studio audience of their most daft, niche, unwise or unacceptable views that they and their teammates must then defend.

Joined by some of the biggest names in comedy each week, Unacceptable will see a live "swingometer" track how many audience members the teams win over with their wit and punchlines as they aim to convince the crowd, with Gamble introducing a series of challenges to force them to practice what they preach.

name: Hva gjorde denne russeren i Norge?
summary: In a sounding Trøndelag, the businessman has been hunting down Norwegian waterworks, ports and properties. We uncover Norwegian security holes and seek him out with a hidden camera.

name: Wild & Fiery
summary: Twenty years ago, a child was secretly switched. The Mu family's true young master, Shen Jibai, was cast out and grew up among ordinary people, living a poor and dangerous life. The false heiress, Mu Zhiyu, returns to the country as a top auctioneer, determined to take back the auction house from her stepmother, Xu Mingzhu. Xu Mingzhu uses Shen Jibai to approach Mu Zhiyu, drawing the two of them into a vortex of power struggles. As they pull against each other within the schemes of the powerful family, they eventually join forces to seek revenge.

name: Полицейский по обмену
summary:
Chinese policeman Desheng is a hereditary officer of the law and a member of the Communist Party, who grew up respecting rules and protocols. They taught him everything: to fight, shoot, negotiate, but he never had a chance to apply the skills: there is perfect order in his neighborhood. But he has learned Russian well and understands our culture. So the hero gets to partner up with the metropolitan Coast.

 Kostya's personal file says that he knows Chinese, although this is not the case. It was a joke, which was why Desheng was assigned to him. Kostya himself knows only a couple of phrases and hieroglyphs from Hong Kong action movies, which his father raised him on. Therefore, he easily distinguishes Chow Yun Fat from Jackie Chan, understands weapons and wears sunglasses. The real service turned out to be more boring than the movies, but Kostya is still trying to add more action to the routine.

name: Secret Sex Lives of Tyrants
summary:
Secret Sex Lives of Tyrants uncovers the private worlds of some of history's most notorious dictators. 

The series examines the sexual power plays, obsessions and abuses that influenced rulers' reigns - and sometimes the fate of nations. From Muammar Gaddafi's secret sex chambers, Fidel Castro's insatiable womanising, Joseph Goebbels' politically charged affairs, Saddam Hussein's sexual brutality, Mao Zedong's concubine network and Idi Amin's murderous polygamy, the series reveals how intimate appetites became deliberate instruments of control.

name: Adolf Hitler: Decoding a Dictator
summary: Explores six different aspects of Adolf Hitler's life and reign, revealing how an uneducated, ordinary man left a legacy of unprecedented evil.

name: Lex
summary: In Lex, when a disgraced former reality star accidentally films a murder in the background of a $20 Cameo video, he finds himself at the center of a global conspiracy — and on the run from powerful forces who want him dead. Using the skills he acquired navigating reality TV's toxic social dynamics, Lex must fight to not get killed, to expose the truth, and most importantly… to get back on TV.

name: Durango
summary: Durango follows Mikey, a ski bum townie chasing a buzz, and Bunny, a homeschooled runaway working as a greasy-spoon waitress. Together they're riding an avalanche of bad decisions and falling in love while running from cops, criminals, and Mikey's wife in pursuit of their own American dream.

name: First Timers on the Frontline
summary: First Timers on the Frontline follows student, intern and newly qualified paramedics as they face real emergencies. The series offers a close look at a new generation of paramedics learning on the job with support from advanced paramedics and senior members of the National Ambulance Service.

name: Hold the Dream
summary: Emma Harte has trained her grand-daughter, Paula, to 'hold the dream' and retain intact the vast business empire that is her legacy from Emma. But will the burden prove too heavy?

name: To Be the Best
summary: Paula feuds with her cousins as she fights to save her grandmother Emma's business.

name: Hard Spell
summary: Britain's best young spellers battle it out in five regional heats, but only one person can go through each day to the final where they will compete for the title of Hard Spell champion.

name: Le Libere Donne
summary: Lucca, 1942. After an act of desperate defiance, Margherita is committed to Maggiano by her husband. Here she meets Mario Tobino, a doctor returning from the front who opposes the coercive methods of the institution. While he rediscovers his old love Paola, now a partisan and persecuted, Mario seeks the truth about Margherita: is she really ill or just a victim of violence?

name: Drift This
summary: All the smoke, all the speed, and all the style!! Drift This is comin' in sideways as Chris Forsberg and Ryan Tuerck take five from their pro cars to bring some variety to the drift game. These two legends of drift pull out all the stops to go full drift in big ol' trucks, teeny li'l cars, things that should never drift, and everything that should have been drifting all along!

name: Day One
summary: Day One follows the story of Ulises Albet, a computer prodigy who left Barcelona and the world of technology after the death of his younger sister. Ten years later, a mysterious call from his former partner and best friend, Samuel Barrera, forces him to return during the Mobile World Congress. Samuel warns him that the world is in danger, leading Ulises to confront his past, technological advances, and the fundamental question: how far can we go without losing what makes us human?

name: Hokuto no Ken: Fist of the North Star
summary: In the year 199X, the world was engulfed in nuclear fire!! Yet...humanity somehow survived!! A lone man with seven scars on his chest emerges. His name is Kenshiro, heir to Hokuto Shinken. In a world where only the strong survive, Kenshiro forges a path with his iron fists!

previousepisode.name: Witness Protection Pup/Eleven Minutes of Fame

name: Liar Game
summary: When Nao Kanzaki receives a strange letter and a suitcase containing 100 million yen, she learns that she has been selected to participate in the LIAR GAME. In this high-stakes psychological battle, lies, deception, and betrayal reign supreme. Naïve and honest, Nao turns to Shinichi Akiyama, a brilliant former con artist, to survive the twisted game. In a game built on lies, can honesty prevail?

name: The Sisaundra Show
summary: The Sisaundra Show is a live daily talk show blending celebrity interviews, musical performances, faith-driven and inspirational conversations designed to uplift, inform and entertain while celebrating Black culture.

name: Point of View (POV)
summary: Point of View (POV) is a live panel talk show centered on the perspectives and lived experiences of diverse Black women, delivering timely discussions on current events, relationships, career, wellness and issues shaping Black communities nationwide.

name: EVO
summary: From the hottest supercars to everyday rides, this series covers everything from track tests to epic road trips to car-of-the-year showdowns.

name: Brasil 70: A Saga do Tri
summary: When legends take the field and a nation dares to dream, history is made. Lace up your soccer shoes: Pelé and his all-star team are coming for the cup.

name: The Master Cutter
summary: A former scout ranger–turned–tailor and secret man-hunter takes in a street-smart girl and her guardian, then is hired to hunt the girl down. Defying the contract, he uncovers that she is his biological daughter and tied to a powerful crime syndicate, forcing him into a brutal war to save his newfound family and confront the ghosts of his past.

name: Fatal Fraud
summary: Fatal Fraud delves into cases where financial schemes spiral into betrayal, violence and murder, exposing the deadly cost of lies fueled by greed.

name: Malcolm in the Middle: Life's Still Unfair
summary: After shielding himself and his daughter from his family for over a decade, Malcolm is dragged back into their orbit when Hal and Lois demand his presence at their 40th anniversary party.

name: On Pace with Pastrana
summary: The 29-year-old has broken nearly every bone in his body on his death-defying path to motorcross glory. Now, Travis is up against the biggest challenge of his professional career: to become a top competitor in NASCAR racing.

name: Sammy's Children's Day
summary:
Set in 1980s Kowloon Walled City, where triads run rampant and corruption infects the police force, He Chusan dreams of studying hard and escaping the chaos. His plans collapse when Xia Liuyi, a triad deputy leader, forcibly pulls him into a criminal scheme. As conspiracies unfold and power struggles intensify, the two men move from reluctant allies to partners in revenge. He Chusan, a calculating yet deeply devoted financial strategist, and Xia Liuyi, a fierce but unexpectedly tender enforcer, find themselves fighting side by side. In a lawless city balanced between black and white, love becomes their most dangerous gamble. Can they carve out a path to survival for each other?

Adapted from the hit novel by She Xie Dian Dian.

name: Asia Express
summary: Diverse couples of both famous and unknown personalities set off on a journey across Asia. They have one euro per day and a big task - to be the first to reach the finish line! The contestants are given challenging tasks along the way, and while their relationships are put to the test, it is mainly their willpower that keeps them afloat. Only those who can handle the pressure, inclement weather and unexpected situations have a chance to win an attractive financial prize.

name: Rafaela y su loco mundo
summary: A surreal comedy where Rafaela and her friends navigate an adolescence full of absurd and wacky situations while trying to save the world before they become adults

name: Bad Choice Good Love
summary: Once known as the "Love Master" for her proactive approach towards romance, Kamoi Hiyori becomes timid after a traumatic breakup with her university boyfriend, Sudo Kei. However, her life faces a drastic turn when she suddenly timeslips back to four years ago, when she was still a university student. Reunited with Kei, Hiyori vows to not date Kei again but her heart begins to waver after experiencing Kei's kindness and thoughtfulness she did not noticed before.

name: Life in Smokey Blue
summary: Sakutaro's former colleague and No. 1 sales rival, Shizuka Kuji, saved him from danger when he was out having a good time one night. When Kuji left the company a step earlier than Sakutaro, he looked at him with envy, thinking that he must have a brilliant second career now. But when Kuji reunites with Sakutaro for the first time in eight years, his sarcastic personality is still the same, but for some reason, he is now working as a translator, looking languid and with long hair...

name: Wild Weather
summary:
Donal MacIntyre is blasted, roasted, frozen and soaked on an epic journey to experience the wildest weather the planet can throw at him. In Wild Weather, the tough man of journalism meets his match in a new series exploring how the world's weather works. From a gruelling marathon in the heat of the Sahara to paragliding through the fury of the monsoon, MacIntyre is tested to the limit.

Wild Weather explores the elements and hears from scientists investigating how the weather works, and those who are trying to tame it. Using state-of-the-art 3D graphics, this wild ride through the weather is brought terrifyingly alive.

name: OG Stories
summary: The unfiltered docuseries gives voice to the OGs, the cultural architects, street legends, and self-made bosses who built empires from nothing. Through cinematic visuals and candid, character-driven conversations, Dash builds with those who've walked the walk, creating a space where game is given, not sold. From surviving the trenches to breaking generational curses, OG Stories captures the mindset, moments, and blueprint of those who've shaped culture and the communities connected to it.

name: Riding on the Wind
summary: The project tells the story of the young prodigy painter Xi Meng of the Song Dynasty and his journey of growth as he eventually collaborates with Emperor Huizong to create the legendary masterpiece A Thousand Li of Rivers and Mountains. Within the imperial painting academy, Xi Meng fights side by side with the guard Aji through life-and-death trials; in a hidden chamber, he humbly studies under an unseen mentor he has never met; and in the imperial court, he boldly questions Emperor Huizong's mistakes in governing the realm. As these three figures—mentor, friend, and adversary—gradually converge into one identity, Xi Meng struggles through conflict and inner turmoil before reaching reconciliation. In the end, he merges himself with the painting, laying down a single stroke of brilliant blue-green that reverberates through the world.

name: Everlasting Moonlight
summary: Wealthy heiress Yu Ming and impoverished student Yang Jingzhi once loved each other deeply, but were forced to part when her family fell from grace. Five years later, Yang Jingzhi rises to become a rising tech tycoon, while Yu Ming struggles to make ends meet and repay debts. Everyone expects him to seek revenge, yet unbeknownst to them, he has never let go. Breaking through the barriers of status and time, the two find their way back to each other with renewed determination.

name: The Secret of the Lost Pearl
summary: A pair of embroidered shoes kicks off the adventure of cultural relics expert Chen Youxi. A four-person team clashes repeatedly with tomb raiders while searching for the Lingxiao Pearl. Yet after securing the first Lingxiao Pearl, they realize they've stumble into an even greater conspiracy...

name: Life, Larry and the Pursuit of Unhappiness
summary:
President and Mrs. Obama wanted to honor America's 250th anniversary and celebrate the unique history of our nation on this special occasion.

...But then Larry David called.

name: Ravalejar
summary: A family business under thread in Barcelona's Raval neighborhood explores how to survive an imminent buyout by an investment fund.

name: Escravos da Fé - Os Arautos do Evangelho
summary: The series investigates allegations of abuse and psychological manipulation by former members of the Catholic group Heralds of the Gospel.

name: Nua na Rede: A Verdade Sobre Rose Leonel
summary: This documentary series follows the story of Brazilian journalist Rose Leonel, who in 2006 became the victim of a massive leak of intimate photos and transformed her pain into activism, leading the fight against digital crimes in Brazil.

name: I Survive In The Villain's Arms Through Psychotherapy
summary: Qi Jiujiu transmigrates into a novel as an heiress engaged to Huo Xize, fated to die. She breaks the engagement and meets Huo Shenye, his younger brother—a villain who craves physical contact and vows to take everything from Huo Xize.

name: Жребий судьбы
summary: Restaurant singer Ksenia marries a military psychologist, who is soon sent to a hot spot. Pregnant Ksenia is thrown out onto the street by her husband's brother, without any documents. An underground doctor delivers the babies prematurely. Three girls are born. Ksenia cannot be saved. Twenty years later, under strange circumstances, the father will have to meet his daughters, the existence of whom he had no idea about.

name: Kill Blue
summary: Legendary hitman Juzo Ogami has never failed an assignment. But after a mission, he's stung by a mysterious wasp and wakes up in the body of a 13-year-old boy! And to make things even weirder, he receives a bizarre new order: infiltrate a middle school. Now the once-feared assassin must balance the chaos of school life with his deadly work, all while searching for a way to regain his adult body!

name: Çirkin
summary: The series follows Meryem, who holds onto life with nothing but good intentions, as she reunites with her one true love, Kadir—now a man whose world has been shaped by power, wealth, and ambition.

name: Los Asesinos de Colosio
summary: This three-part docuseries chronicles the search for answers in the 1994 assassination of Mexican political candidate Luis Donaldo Colosio.

name: Fakhr El Dilta
summary: Mohamed Salah Fakhr, an ambitious young man from a Delta village, strives to break into advertising, determined to prove that success depends on belief in a dream, not living in Cairo.

name: Las Autenticas Aventuras del Profesor Thompson
I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day
summary: At a secret academy where orphaned children are raised as weapons, death is routine and grief is forbidden. Sheena, a 14-year-old who questions this brutal life, meets Mimi, a mysterious, blood-soaked girl who refuses to break. In a world built on violence, the two cling to fragile hope and fight to hold on to their humanity.

name: Botan Kamiina Fully Blossoms When Drunk
summary: New university life, new dormmates…and a whole new world of drinks! Botan Kamiina takes her first sip of alcohol after spotting the quiet dorm leader, Ibuki Tonami, enjoying a highball alone. From shochu to whisky, Botan shares the joy of drinking with friends, while Ibuki slowly learns that some pleasures are better when shared.

name: Tystnaden
summary: When Linus suddenly disappears without a trace one day, his closest friends gather to search. Why is Linus missing? And what has happened?

name: Steel Ball Run: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
summary: America, 1890. Johnny Joestar, a genius jockey now paralyzed from the waist down, chases after outlaw Gyro Zeppeli in a tough cross-continent horse race.

name: Amor Animal
summary: Amor Animal is an Argentinian Original, fictional drama series following Kaia, a trap artist from the outskirts of the city, who meets Nico, an upper-class young man with existential angst. Despite their different realities and the outside forces pushing them apart, they try to make space for their love to grow, and in doing so, unleash a gang war.

name: Monsieur Molina
summary: As a retired schoolteacher, Mr. Molina decides to become a judge in his local jurisdiction, a job he takes to relieve the court of minor cases, and in which he will have to deal with people from his neighborhood involved in petty crimes.

name: David: King of Israel
summary: The four-part docudrama series David: King of Israel, hosted by Zachary Levi, premieres on Fox Nation on February 26, 2026. The series explores the life of the biblical King David, with new 45-minute episodes airing weekly. The dynamic life of King David: giant killer, renegade warrior, and unifier of Israel under his crown.

name: Beneath the Brilliance
summary: Orphaned Shen Moran learned from a young age to hide her true self in order to survive. After being adopted, she was mistreated and exploited by her adoptive mother, but eventually broke free from her control and made her way to the entertainment industry. To climb higher, she strategically leveraged Lin Qian, who once bullied her, and allied with Su Nian, the biological heiress of a prominent family. Her boyfriend, Gu Yechen, saw the tenderness and sincerity beneath her fierce exterior and silently protected her all along. Just as Shen was on the verge of winning Best Actress, Gu Yechen was ambushed while saving her.

name: Back to Your Heart
summary: A misunderstanding brings software engineer Min Hui and CEO Xin Qi together, leading them into an unexpected love, until another misunderstanding tears them apart. Years later, fate brings them face-to-face again at work. As workplace tensions, regret, and lingering feelings collide, they are drawn into a bittersweet romance that leads them back to the love they never truly left behind.

name: Help! I Bought It at Auction with Sarah Beeny
summary: Help! I Bought It at Auction with Sarah Beeny explores the drama, risk, and reward of buying property at auction. From bargain terraces to sprawling mansions—and even the occasional castle—each episode follows gripping real-life stories of buyers seeking a bargain and gambling their life savings in pursuit of their dream home. But with many properties in dire need of renovation, the journey is rarely straightforward. Behind every wall and beneath every floorboard could lie a costly surprise.

name: How to Suffer 101
summary: When former psychotherapist Fai is hired to teach Happiness, a newly offered course aimed at helping students to get to know and understand themselves, she finds that nothing is as easy as she'd thought. A troubled student in her class, Kla, insists that happiness does not exist. Fai often finds herself helping him, despite what he wants. In her class, she also meets Miu, a depressed medical student; Win, Miu's perfectionist and controlling boyfriend; Good, a cheery freshie with no friends; and Chai, an electrical engineering student who identifies as a woman. Fai also reconnects with Itt, a popular friend from her high school days and former boyband member turned music professor. Though a matter from the past has erected walls between them, the two have to come together to help their students, particularly Kla, who's begun to find love and a sense of safety through Fai's class and the friends he's made. However, their progress is threatened as the class is attacked on social mead and Fai faces an investigative committee.

name: The Idol Game
summary: The story of a renowned family of surgeons who hold significant power in Thailand's cosmetic surgery industry. Their enormous profits from the business become a source of internal conflict within the family. Especially between Dr. Thicha, the ambitious oldest sister, and Dr. Tan, the youngest brother struggling to find his place in the family. Meanwhile, the dangers of cyberspace are shown with Itthichai or "It," an expert programmer from a government agency, who must solve an mystery that links cybercrime to the dark side of the cosmetic surgery industry.

name: Win the Mall
summary:
Do you think shopping should be considered an Olympic sport? Bargain hunt like it's a full-time job? Is retail therapy your form of … actual therapy?

Then get ready for the shopping spree of a lifetime, because the new series Win the Mall is the ultimate fantasy retail experience. This high-stakes competition transforms a classic American shopping mall into a thrilling game of strategy and unexpected twists. Over the season, 10 teams of expert shoppers face off against each other as they attempt to gain control of storefronts, increase their spending power, and outmaneuver their rivals.

name: Dujupsorn
summary: "Fah" Dujupsorn's mother M.L. Wilairampha remains resentful of M.R. Ronnaphi Juthathep for breaking a promise to marry her. Fah loves her mother so much that she is ready to take revenge on the Juthatheps; she is to apply for a job at a Juthathep-owned company and seduce M.L. Ronnaphum Juthathep to fall for her, only to hurt him. Ironically, it is Fah who falls in love; she is stunned when she meets the president of the company, Major M.L. Asira Juthathep, the eldest son of M.R. Tharathorn, as he is the charming and handsome soldier from her past who had once saved her life. She now faces the toughest decision of her life: revenge may not be her choice, but it is her destiny.

name: Poncheewan
summary: The bright and beautiful cousins of Dhevaprom—Cheewan and Poncheewa—are close like sisters and do everything together, including studying in Switzerland. Meanwhile, M.L. Saruj Juthathep, son of M.R. Pavornruj and Princess Wanrasa, is the First Secretary of the Thai Embassy in Bern, whose job is to support Thai students. This is a perfect setting for romance, but not a love triangle. Things get complicated when Cheewan falls for Saruj while she is supposed to play Cupid for her Poncheewa and Saruj. They become entangled in a web of lies and jealousy that threatens to tear apart the cousins' once unbreakable bond. Will Cheewan follow her heart and be one with Saruj, or will she remain loyal to Poncheewa? For whom does Saruj harbour true feelings?

name: Jeff Dunham's The Cars That Drove Us
summary: Cars began rolling off the assembly line over 100 years ago. Two billion vehicles later, we still can't get enough. The Cars That Drove Us takes viewers into Jeff Dunham's garage - home to 130 legendary cars. Joined by his cast of characters, Dunham reveals the storied history of era-defining rides, from the Corvette Stingray to the ill-fated Vector W8, as told by the engineers, artists, and socket slingers who built them.

name: Glory Back
summary: Empress Gu Qing, betrayed and perished in flames, is reborn as Feng Qing, a lowly seamstress in the Imperial Wardrobe Bureau. To protect her sister Gu Wan and uncover the truth behind her death, she navigates the treacherous harem, joining forces with her younger brother, Imperial Physician Gu Xuan. As she schemes amidst the palace's shadowy powers, her fate becomes inextricably tangled with Emperor Xiao Luo. Their bond rekindled with every confrontation.

name: Wo Xi Huan De Ren Bian Cheng Mao Shi Zen Yang De Ti Yan
The 50
summary: 50 players navigate a chaotic Mahal where rules don't exist. In this lawless game, alliances form and break, betrayals matter, and each turn affects all contestants.

name: Sold Out on You
summary: A workaholic home shopping host heads to the countryside to get her sales back on top, but a mysterious farmer shakes up her plans — and her heart

name: Koi ni Ochita Ohitori Sama: Stendhal no Renairon
Ein Sehreya
summary: Adel, a young surveillance installer, secretly plants cameras for money and accidentally witnesses a murder, drawing him into a dangerous network of corruption that forces him to fight to protect his family.

name: Agents of the Four Seasons: Dance of Spring
summary: When the Agent of Spring, Hinagiku Kayo, is abducted, spring itself vanishes—plunging the world into unending winter. Refusing to give up, her devoted guard, Sakura Himedaka, searches for her for years. When Hinagiku suddenly returns, the two set out to restore the lost season, face the past that tore them apart, and reclaim the warmth they refuse to lose again.

name: Time Rescue
summary: An unexpected accident shatters a once-happy family, leaving Wen Xin as the sole survivor. By chance, she obtains a magical lantern that allows communication across time. Joining forces with Sun Wen from twelve days in the past, the two embark on a desperate race against time to save the family. As they attempt to change fate, the rescue becomes increasingly perilous, revealing that the accident was not a simple tragedy but the beginning of a web of hidden conspiracies and looming dangers.

name: Runaway Healer
summary: Ji Bai, a gifted young physician, flees an arranged marriage only to run into a group of bandits—led by none other than her never-before-met runaway fiancé, Xiao Heyan. Forced into an uneasy alliance, the mismatched pair become entangled in mysterious illnesses and the hidden intrigues of a medicinal hall. As they navigate life-and-death trials together, unexpected feelings begin to grow. Yet just as the truth comes to light, Xiao Heyan falls into an eternal slumber, poisoned by a deadly gu toxin…

name: The Dark Gold
summary: Amid sweeping reforms in the mining industry, the quiet village of Dayang is thrust into turmoil. An ordinary villager, Yang Gang, is forced into the dangerous undercurrents of the mines in order to protect his family. Together with his brothers, he takes a desperate risk by venturing into a forbidden mine shaft, only to uncover a hidden secret tied to a gold deposit. From that moment on, he becomes entangled in a web of corruption and crime. As pressure mounts from the mine's authorities, rival factions clash both openly and in the shadows, and a series of misfortunes befall those around him. Caught between survival and moral integrity, Yang Gang faces increasingly difficult choices. Under the lure of "black gold," the battle between good and evil intensifies, and each decision he makes begins to shape the fate of the entire village. In the end, where will this high-stakes game surrounding the gold mine lead?

name: Dongbei's Back
summary: When Zhou Dongbei returns to his hometown in Northeast China, he unexpectedly digs up a bucket of gold in his own backyard. With his buddies and his longtime crush by his side, he sets out on an ambitious entrepreneurial journey, launching one outrageous business venture after another—from "KenDeQi" and "Hali Baba" to "Penguin QQ." But his longtime rival, Wang Jinsheng, is always close behind, pulling every trick in the book to bring him down. Just as Zhou Dongbei seems poised to finally defeat his rival, a long-buried secret at the hospital suddenly comes to light—revealing that the people he thought were family and enemies may have been mixed up all along.

name: Chong Sheng Huang Nian Di Ping Jie Gui
The Verdict
summary: Broadcast Legend Christopher "Mad Dog" Russo gives the definitive take on the greatest debates in sports.

name: Finlay Donovan Is Killing It
summary: Finlay Donovan Is Killing It follows a struggling novelist and single mom on the verge of losing custody of her kids, who is mistaken for an assassin and offered life-changing money for one kill.

name: O11CE: Nueva generación
summary: After six years of success in European soccer, Gabo, Dedé, and Ricky decide to visit IAD, the Academic Sports Institute, which saw them grow up, and surprise them. But they are the ones who get the surprise: the IAD is not as it used to be and the Golden Hawks, the soccer team they were part of, is aimless, unmotivated, and on the verge of being relegates. Now they must restore the IAD's glory and the pride of being an Hawk: a new chapter begins, full of passion and plenty of soccer!

name: Le Morning Night
summary: After skyrocketing to fame as the host of *Morning Live* for just 18 months, Michaël Youn is finally back on M6, 20 years later. And since the network has given him free rein, you'll see that he hasn't lost any of his wildness or his irreverence.

name: L'humour à la plage
summary: Kev Adams hosts a stand-up comedy show on the beach with various French comedians.

name: Les 100 plus grands...
summary: Ranking of 100 clips (bloopers, stunts, magic, or surprises) from 100th to 1st.

name: Les Nuls, L'émission
summary: Les Nuls The show is a comedy show modeled on Saturday Night Live with Les Nuls broadcast on Canal+ from October 13, 1990 to March 28, 1992. Les Nuls were accompanied by a guest actor who played their sketches with them and a musical guest who performed two songs live. The show was also full of fake ads and fake trailers, not to mention L'édition, a fake newscast presented by Maurice Chevalier (Alain Chabat) and Pénélope Solète (Chantal Lauby).

name: Les mots d'Eric et Ramzy
summary: Les mots d'Eric et Ramzy is a French comedy show featuring the iconic duo Eric Judor and Ramzy Bedia. It is a series of short, absurdist sketches where the duo plays with language and situations, typical of their surreal humor style.

name: Vikram On Duty
summary: Battling his past and personal demons, a disgraced but brilliant supercop will stop at nothing to solve crimes and earn back the uniform that defined him

name: The Legend of Lu Xiaofeng
summary: As mysterious cases shake the martial arts world, Wuwang Pavilion offers Lu Xiaofeng a miracle cure for blindness if he can solve a series of impossible crimes. Determined to restore his best friend Hua Manlou's sight, Lu Xiaofeng takes on the challenge. From deadly flower curses and mysterious gambling houses to haunted islands and sinister desert inns, each case grows stranger and more dangerous. With his sharp mind, signature skills, and trusted allies including Hua Manlou, Ximen Chuixue and Sikong Zhaixing, Lu Xiaofeng uncovers the truth behind every mystery and ultimately stops a conspiracy threatening the entire martial world.

name: Hirayasumi
summary: At 29 years old, carefree Hiroto Ikuta doesn't have a girlfriend, a full-time job, or a plan for the future—and he couldn't be happier. Hiroto's breezy attitude isn't easy for everyone to understand, though. In a world filled with anxiety, confusion, and grief, Hiroto and the people around him are all just doing their best to figure out this thing called life.

name: Mao
summary: Nanoka survived a car accident that killed her parents when she was young. Her only memory was a mysterious burning shopping street that didn't match any official reports. Years later, rumors of ghosts, she returns to the site and is transported back to early 20th-century Japan. Where she encounters a mysterious man named Mao, claiming that Nanoka isn't human, but an ayakashi (demon).

name: Meantime
summary: Meantime follows Felix McAveety, a full-time addict whose best friend is found murdered in a Glasgow park, leaving him as the police's most convenient suspect. In a fog of intoxication and paranoia, Felix sets out to clear his name, enlisting the help of an ageing former Detective Inspector turned crime novelist and a chaotic friend. Their search for the truth becomes an exhilarating and frequently laugh-out-loud race through the murkier edges of contemporary Scotland, as events rapidly spiral out of control around him.

name: This Is a Gardening Show
summary: Zach Galifianakis digs into the world of gardening, interviewing curious kids and eccentric experts in a funny, oddball celebration of the food we eat.

name: Единственный мужчина
summary: The jewels of a great emperor, kidnappings, explosions and chases, acts of sabotage, a love that has endured through the years, separation and the discovery of happiness... Time and distance have separated them, the marriage of their beloved and only man to another, betrayal and mutual accusations, but perhaps Andrei and Tuan's dreams are destined to come true? Classmates and friends Andrei Voloshin and Oleg Vetrov compete in everything: love and work, even their affection for a young secretary. To Vetrov's chagrin, Voloshin always wins, the reason being his talent and ability to appreciate people, but Vetrov refuses to accept this. Immediately after graduating from college, the friends end up in Professor Gromov's experimental lab and travel with him to Vietnam to build a secret military bridge. These specialists from the Soviet Union are tasked with helping the Vietnamese recover from the war with the United States. There, they fall in love with a local translator, Tuan...

name: Ultras
summary: The future of fandom? Across Scottish football, ultras groups are transforming match days. Beyond the headlines of flares and trouble is a powerful sense of belonging for young men.

name: American Gladiators
summary: The iconic competition returns with each episode featuring weekend warriors from across the nation stepping into the Arena to face 16 powerful new Gladiators. From classic events like Joust, Powerball, Hang Tough, and The Wall, to high-impact new challenges including The Ring and Collision, every showdown demands pure grit, strategy, and heart. Only one man and one woman will conquer the Arena, claim $100,000, and earn the title of American Gladiator Champion.

name: Folles verden
summary: Erik Follestad takes Josefine Engmann and Jonas Bariås on a trip to show you why he loves Norwegian ice hockey.

name: Conspiracies & Coverups
summary: Driven by a relentless hunt for the truth, Bustamante pulls back the curtain on modern-day mysteries that blur the line between fact and fiction. Using his unique perspective and insider techniques, he investigates, pressure-tests, and challenges prevailing narratives to reveal the hidden forces behind these events and the motives used to manipulate the truth.

name: Unicorn Academy: Secrets Revealed
summary: Follow Sophia and her friends as they embark on a glimmering quest to unlock Unicorn Island's mysteries and banish Grimoria — and Ravenzella — for good!

name: Hypnotic
summary: After mysteriously losing her parents as a child, a young woman infiltrates the family responsible, seeking revenge by tearing them apart.

name: Dokkaew Kahlong
summary: Dokkaew lives with her father and stepmother. Afraid that her husband's money will go to her stepdaughter, Dokkaew's stepmother tried to kill them in an accident. While struggling to get up from the accident, which hurt her father, Dokkaew is again hit by a car driven by Chit's mother who takes her to the hospital where she is diagnosed with amnesia. Chit's mother takes Dokkaew to her own house and names her Kahlong. Chit believes that Kahlong is faking her amnesia to take advantage of his naive mother and is suspicious of her while being attracted to her as well. Dokkaew's friend who is trying to find her meets with Chit's sister without knowing the relationship.

name: Kiss of the Cobra
summary: 500 years ago, the snake queen goddess was condemned to burn to death by her lover Prince Chaiyawong. Present day, she awaits for her lover to return to punish him for a love debt that he owes and vows vengeance upon Maneewan, the woman who stole her lover's heart.

name: Ultra Q
summary: As supernatural events and monster attacks rock Japan, the military and government look to be overwhelmed. Three intrepid young investigators—two pilots and a reporter—take it upon themselves to study these unexplained phenomena in order to inform and protect the public. With allies and science aiding them on their journey, the trio must separate myth from history as they explore the greater mysteries of these occurrences: are these unrelated, or is this barrage somehow a portent of things even worse to come?

name: A Kiképzés
summary: A military sports reality show commissioned by the Ministry of Defense. The best 24 players (men and women), selected in advance, form four teams and compete against each other in a team competition based on military training, pushing their own physical and mental limits.

name: Exploring Quantum History with Brian Greene
summary: Quantum physics? Theoretical physicist Brian Greene helps you understand its origins and its impact on today's world.

name: Határtalan szerelem
summary: We can follow the matchmaking efforts of six single Hungarian entrepreneurs living abroad. The show gives an insight into the lives of Hungarians living and working in beautiful foreign landscapes. Those applying to them have to travel far and wide to get to know them, which, in addition to the matchmaking, provides even more excitement and experience for matchmakers and candidates. The host of Határtalan szerelem is Babett Köllő, who keeps in touch with matchmakers from Hungary and asks them about their feelings.

name: Curious Minds: Quantum Computing
summary: What's a qubit? How do you visualize an atom? Welcome to the new world of quantum computing!

name: Uncorked
summary: Uncorked delves into the life of a talented but self-destructive winemaker who returns to Napa for her second chance at love, legacy and that elusive 100-point wine. Not that she's constantly refreshing WineSpectator.com or anything. This is a woman whose greatest passion is also her fatal flaw — a failing that usually begins before lunch on Tuesday.

name: Το Τρίτο Σταφάνι
summary:
Based on the classic Greek novel of the same name by Kostas Tachtsis.

Nina is a middle aged woman living in Athens in the late 1930s, while Hecuba is an older woman who moves from Thessaloniki to Athens with her adult children. From their first meeting at Nina's home, the two women form a close friendship.

As they share memories and stories from their lives, their personal experiences bring to life the struggles, passions and hardships of ordinary people in modern Greece, against the backdrop of a country undergoing profound social and historical change.

name: The Moment I Met You
summary: Detective Mao Buyu is determined to marry Chu Yunchang, unaware that she is secretly the leader of a powerful thieves' guild. To earn the promotion he needs for their future, Mao Buyu vows to capture the notorious "Jade Squirrel." Torn between her family's legacy and the man she loves, Yunchang must navigate a double life as a high-stakes cat-and-mouse game begins.

name: Soft-Hearted God
summary: Ye Zhao, a lofty and ruthless god, falls into the mortal world for love. Princess Chu Xihe of the royal family carries the secret of a dual identity, and the two become powerful rivals entangled in a sea of love and hatred. Across a hundred years, their relationship shifts from love at first sight to bone-deep resentment, as a pure yet fateful romance transcends reincarnation—unraveling hidden truths amid their obsessive bond and the greater duty to family and nation.

name: Fireworks
summary: Qiao Nian, the obedient daughter of a powerful conglomerate family, falls to her death under mysterious circumstances, but her story doesn't end there. Unable to move on, her spirit possesses the body of Jiang Zecheng, a man entangled in the dangerous world surrounding her family. With only 7 days to reclaim her original body before both souls are destroyed forever, the unlikely duo race against time, digging through dark secrets, exposing hidden enemies, and outsmarting the villains who orchestrated her fall. What began as a quiet girl's tragic end becomes a fierce battle for justice and the truth buried beneath wealth and power.

name: Babies
summary: Babies is a warm and touching drama which explores the delicate tightrope of love and loss in a young couple's desire to become parents. Lisa and Stephen are dealing with the painful struggle of pregnancy loss while life continues around them. However, despite facing dark times of grief and loneliness, they are finding their way through it with a burning sense of hope, humour, and love, realising the strength of their relationship, which will ultimately bring them closer than ever.

name: Lose My Heart to You
summary: After a heart transplant, ruthless CEO Gu Tiancheng finds himself inexplicably drawn to his workplace rival, secretary Lin Jiaqi. As they clash and collaborate, they slowly discover each other's true feelings and unite to fight for a common goal.

name: Braving the Famine with My Wife
summary: Zhao Dong, an immortal sovereign obsessed with enlightenment and blind to earthly attachments, is backstabbed by his immortal beloved and enters a calamity with nothing but regret. After rebirth, he inhabits the body of a country thug also named Zhao Dong. Through his dual existence as immortal and mortal, he comes to understand that everything has its limits. Determined to stay in the mortal realm, he vows to right his past wrongs and reawaken the Dao.

name: The Matter of Facts
summary: In an era defined by trolls, Chatbots, misinformation and disinformation, truth and lies can be indistinguishable. The Matter of Facts takes audiences to the frontline of the global information wars, where information is manipulated to influence what we believe, how we behave and who we vote for.

name: Pécheresses
summary: Cassidy, a 17-year-old rebel, is fired from the family caravan for posting kinky lesbian videos on a camgirls site while she is still a minor. Her mother enrolls her in a Catholic boarding school to punish her but above all to get rid of her. Cassidy must buy back a conduct by integrating into this boarding school with strict rules.

name: Bandi
summary: Following the death of their mother, their pillar and their landmark, eleven siblings aged 7 to 23 struggle to remain united in the face of adversity. For some, drug trafficking seems to be the only way out. This choice, far from being unanimous, puts a strain on the strength of family ties.

name: Lakásvadászok
summary: Hungarian real estate agents fight for the favor of couples and families who are about to buy a home, while also competing with each other. A lot depends on who offers the most attractive, best-value home, and who manages to best understand the tastes and needs of buyers.

name: Tizenkét okos ember
summary: In the studio, a player is selected from twelve smart people who decide whether the twelve statements are true or false. The answers are not evaluated immediately, the player has to mark how many of his answers he thinks are correct – this is the winning zone. If he gets it right, he can win up to twelve million HUFs, if not, he leaves empty-handed. Meanwhile, the host makes the game even more tense with offers and bluffs.

name: K9 PD with Jim Belushi
summary: K9 PD with Jim Belushi showcases intense moments caught on camera of officers and their K9 partners facing high-stakes calls, told through gripping footage from surveillance cameras, body and dash cams, drones and more. Actor and lifelong K9 advocate Jim Belushi returns to the world of heroic K9s—only this time, it's for real—serving as host of the series, which captures the courage, precision, and raw instinct behind one of law enforcement's most formidable partnerships.

name: Secrets of the Bees
summary: Explorer Bertie Gregory uncovers the hidden world of bees, revealing their vital role in pollinating the world's food and their astonishing intelligence.

name: I Made Friends with the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class
summary: Maki Maehara, the class outcast, finally makes his first friend: Umi Asanagi, the second-prettiest girl in class and the center of everyone's attention. He's convinced she's out of his league, but as their unlikely friendship grows, Maki starts to wonder…could there be more than just friendship between them?

name: Tight-rope
summary: Tightrope tells the tale of the reluctant heir of a yakuza family and his childhood friend, and follows their love relationship that started budding in their school days and keeps developing slowly but surely.

name: Maiden Rose
summary: Video adaptation of Fusanosuke Inariya's Hyakujitsu no Bara (Maiden Rose) manga. The military story centers on the relationship between Commander Taki Reizen of the 15th Armored Division "Rosen Maiden" and Klaus "Mad Dog" von Wolfstadt, a knight and Taki's faithful subordinate.

previousepisode.name: The Flower of the Son of Heaven

name: Mandarine & Cow
summary: Two hyperactive kids, a time traveling mom, a dad who is a cell phone and a talking cow.

name: Club Dorothée
summary: Presented by a team of five hosts, the show is centered around the star host Dorothée. The show was complemented by numerous cartoons, television series, sitcoms, games, competitions and educational sections.

name: Caliméro
summary: With his big heart, three eager companions, and an old mill teeming with incredible inventions, Calimero sets off on wild adventures to put right all those things in life that are just not fair. Between school and secret meetings in their workshop, our four friends have a whale of a time! They invite children of all ages to join them on their explosive adventures and take a fresh look at the world around them with an open heart.

name: Wedge of Love
summary: The story focuses on the love and conflict between 3 main characters, Iason Mink, Riki and Guy. The background takes place in a future computer-controlled society on the planet of Amoy and focuses on Riki, a resident of the Ceres slums. In the capital city of Tanagura where the elite class is divided into different ranks that are based on their hair colours, elites are allowed to keep slaves as pets to perform sexual acts for their voyeurism entertainment and are forbidden to interact sexually with them. Iason, the highest of elites, has forced Riki to become his pet and is obsessed with keeping Riki for himself. Riki keeps this secret of his former lover, Guy. Riki is unsure of whether he should continue to resist Iason or surrender to him.

name: Ai no Kusabi
summary: The story is set in the future on the planet named Amoi which is controlled by a supercomputer named Jupiter. Among the mostly male human population, the blond-haired elite class is allowed to temporarily keep slaves as luxury pets. One elite member, Iason, encounters a lower class slum mongrel named Riki and decides to forcibly take him as a pet which is unusual and taboo in elite society. However, Iason keeps Riki longer than it is socially approved, and rumors abound about their possible relationship.

name: The Challenger
summary: The Challenger tells the story of one of the most defining moments in space history, both the unprecedented events leading up to the tragedy, and the shocking investigation that followed. As the members of the 1986 Rogers Commission interrogate the complex inner workings of the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) to find what, or who, was responsible for the Challenger's doomed fate, the show explores Commission member Ride's personal journey. It follows her, and the rest of the diverse Astronaut Class of '78, through the ranks of the shuttle program, through initial recruitment and training, professional and personal highs and lows, until her historic glass ceiling moment as she becomes the first American woman in space.

name: This Summer Will Be Different
summary: This Summer Will Be Different is a simmering, sun-soaked romance set across multiple summers on Prince Edward Island about Lucy, a young woman navigating her 20s and her first real love with her best friend's brother, the one person she was never supposed to fall for.

name: Vida perra
summary: A Madrid dog park becomes a meeting point for a diverse group of neighbors of different ages, interests, and perspectives, with completely different jobs, families, and pasts, united by one thing: their love for dogs.

name: Dandelion
summary:
Set within the Send-Off Department of the Japanese Angel Federation, Dandelion follows "Angels" Tetsuo Tanba and Misaki Kurogane as they scramble to track down Earthbound spirits—souls unable to move on and find peace—and gently guide them to pass on.

The angels find themselves struggling to meet their daily tasks. However, Tetsuo Tanba and his leader, Misaki Kurogane, who make up the 21st Division's Dandelion Clan, chose to take things at their own pace: instead of rushing through cases, they take time with each spirit, listening to their regrets and helping them resolve what's holding them back.

One day, they encounter the Earthbound spirit of an elderly man who is running at full speed, trying desperately to escape.

previousepisode.name: Seize the Moment! Do it Now!

name: Ichijyoma Mankitsu Gurashi!
summary:
Meiko, a country girl, enrolls in a prestigious all-girls school under the condition that she joins a volunteer program. But instead of a typical school service, she finds herself living and working at a manga cafe!

Surprisingly, life in a cramped booth isn't so bad—and with a staff full of cute high school girls, it might even be fun!

Come enjoy the charm of a manga cafe filled with high school girls!

name: Por cien millones
summary: In 1981 three mechanics from Zaragoza, Alfonso, Jorge and Gabi, burdened by debts and after months without work, decide to kidnap the top scorer of the League, Enrique Castro "Quini", the striker of FC Barcelona. In exchange for their release they ask for 100 million pesetas. But soon they discover, and the hard way, that life is not like the movies. And that being bad, when you are good, is not easy at all.

name: Marika's Love Meter Malfunction
summary: Confessing to my childhood friend Marika was impossible for someone as unpopular as me. So, I did what any desperate boy would do—I wished upon a shooting star! When I woke up, that dream had come true?! I could see a love meter for people, just like in a love simulation game. Once I realized this was real and not a dream I went straight to see Marika. Her love meter was so low it had broken and practically fallen all the way to hell! If she hated me so much why was she so nice?! Is this how she really felt or...?!

name: Yowayowa Sensei
summary:
When the new term starts, second-year student Abikura discovers that his homeroom teacher is none other than Hiyori Hiwamura, infamously known as "Scary-Scary Sensei," a woman rumored to curse anyone who crosses her.

But one day, Abikura accidentally witnesses a completely unexpected side of his fearsome teacher after school. The striking contrast between her fearsome image and her hidden personality is utterly irresistible!

Brace yourself for Gap Moe overload in this tender romantic comedy that's sure to ignite your protective instincts!

previousepisode.name: A Weak and Wimpy Jump Rope Tournament

name: The Klutzy Class Monitor and the Girl with the Short Skirt
summary: Every morning, Sakuradaimon-kun enforces the rules at the school gate, stopping Poem-chan for her too-short skirt. But when they're thrown together in remedial class, she discovers his secret—the serious, uptight Sakuradaimon-kun is hopeless at studying! As they clash, bicker, and stumble through school life together, the two opposites slowly draw closer and form an unexpected friendship.

previousepisode.name: The Klutzy Class Monitor and the Girl with the Short Skirt

name: 82Challenge
summary: The rookie boy group interacting with their American fans on a bigger scale than ever before through '82Challenge'.

name: hello82
summary: K-pop channel designed for international fans.

previousepisode.name: Can K-pop idols rap to a Kendrick Lamar song? | Get On The Mic! | JENNIE, Lady Gaga

name: Love Nature
summary:
Love Nature is a new initiative to create multiple short films, spotlighting positive environmental stories from across the UK.   

Each film, approximately three minutes long, will showcase inspiring campaigns and grassroots efforts within local communities, supporting and protecting nature. Produced in collaboration with regional independent production companies, the films aim to bring authentic, local voices to the forefront of environmental storytelling.

name: Seeking Persephone
summary: Persephone marries the feared, scarred Duke of Kielder to save her family. Her gentle persistence begins to soften his guarded heart, but when danger strikes, he must choose between protecting himself or losing the woman he's grown to love.

name: Happy
summary: Twenty-eight-year-old Sheng Kai Xin is bankrupt, unemployed, and being chased by debt collectors. Standing at the lowest point in his life, he finally finds a job, but with it, he also encounters an inexplicable event. On his first day at work, he stood nervously at the villa's entrance, clutching his custom-made suit. The moment he saw CEO Sen Ho, he was struck dumb... That cold, handsome face was unmistakably that of his childhood friend, Gu Yi Sen, who had disappeared without a word ten years ago. Gu Yi Sen looked at him like a stranger as he immediately tried to fire him, beginning his arduous journey of tormenting Sheng Kai Xin. However, "happiness (kaixin)" was the key to Sheng Kai Xin's life, and many absurd and hilarious situations unfolded between them.

name: Gold Land
summary: A young woman working as an airport security agent accidentally comes into possession of a smuggling ring's gold bars. Caught in a chaotic whirlwind of greed and betrayal among various parties vying for the gold, she becomes consumed by the desire to claim it all for herself.

name: Morning Call
summary: Morning Call, anchored by Morgan Brennan, delivers the essential market intelligence that drives the trading day ahead. The program captures breaking business news as it unfolds and tracks pre‑market equity moves, commodity swings, U.S. futures, and overnight action across global markets.

name: Headmaster
summary: The relationship between the headmaster of an elite California private school and his students and faculty.

previousepisode.name: Guess Who's Not Coming to Dinner

name: Godziban
summary: Welcome to the magical world of Godziban, where the beloved Godzilla family takes center stage in an entirely new and whimsical way! This YouTube playlist assembles the charming episodes of Godziban, showcasing the delightful adventures of Godzilla-kun, Minilla, and Little, as they explore life's lessons with humor and heart. From the segment 'Go! Go! Godzilla-kun,' where Godzilla-kun and his brothers embark on exciting adventures, to the reflective 'Hedoji,' where philosophical thoughts are shared between Hedoji and Hedochi, Godziban offers a rich tapestry of storytelling. Join in on the fun with 'Kaijū Step Wandabada,' a segment aimed at the youngest Kaiju fans, where Baby Mothra, Baby Rodan, and other adorable monsters learn about friendship and cooperation. Experience the joy of 'Monster Puppet Show: Go! Go! Godzilla-kun,' a puppet-driven segment that brings our favorite monsters to life in a captivating new style. Godziban presents Godzilla and his fellow Kaiju in a light never seen before, blending traditional Japanese theater with modern puppetry techniques. Whether you're a lifelong Godzilla aficionado or a curious newcomer, this playlist invites you to a world filled with creativity, laughter, and inspiration.

name: The TMF Story
summary: Thirty years after the launch of The Music Factory (better known as TMF), the founders, VJs, and other people involved look back on their time at the channel. Starting Thursday, May 1, you can watch the two-part documentary The TMF Story on Videoland. The documentary reflects on the rise and fall of the music channel The Music Factory, featuring special attention to the VJs, the programs that aired on the channel, and the TMF Awards.

name: Adarsh Baal Vidyalaya
summary: In a dysfunctional Delhi Government School, a laidback headmaster's attempt at a fully paid Cambridge trip sparks a chaotic makeover attempt - forcing a ragtag team of teachers to fix the broken system, one blackboard lesson at a time.

name: Over de A4
summary: We follow the day-to-day operations on and around the A4. Reports come in from various locations along the highway, ranging from traffic incidents and breakdowns to traffic stops and assistance at gas stations. We see how traffic officers, tow truck drivers, Roadside Assistance staff, and gas station attendants handle these situations.

name: Enigma Variations
summary: Enigma Variations tells the story of Paul, a man remade by the lovers who ignite and undo him across ten transformative years. It's an intimate yet sweeping portrait of masculinity, sexuality, and modern love—and in a world of endless choices, it asks the question: will we know when we've found the one?

name: Taste of Art
summary: Ready, set, chef! This creative cooking competition is next level, with teams not only having to compete on taste, but also spectacular presentation. Judged by MasterChef Australia's Melissa Leong and globally renowned chef Vaughan Mabee.

name: Andy's Dino Island
summary: Andy and Jen travel back in time for epic adventures on an island filled with dinosaurs! From Dino Island, the intrepid duo unravel mysteries, solve problems and make exciting new discoveries.

name: Ben Fogle in China
summary:
Ben Fogle embarks on a once-in-a-lifetime journey to China to see its staggering sights, meet its biggest characters, go beyond the stereotypes and discover its true story. Ben delves into an epic 3000-year tale of how China got to now – how centuries of Imperial rule gave way to Communist revolution and the breakneck economic transformation of recent years.

From ancient temples to mega-factories and glittering modern cities, Ben is on a mission to get under the skin of China - how it sees itself in the world and how it's shaping the future for us all. But above all it's a journey of wonder amid the amazing visual splendour of the real China today.

name: Sam & Ade Go Birding
summary:
Sam & Ade Go Birding follows good friends Samuel West and Adrian Edmondson on a spectacular birdwatching quest across the British Isles. For Sam, birding is a long-standing passion - he's been recording his sightings for twenty years and has now seen over 400 British species, though he'll always grab any opportunity to add to his list. For Adrian, the hobby is something new: he's bird-curious. Despite living in the countryside for more than twenty years, Ade's frustrated not to know more about the birds around him and now wants to learn with his enthusiastic friend - if they can stop for lunch, stay in a nice cottage and have the odd pint along the way.   

Across three weekend adventures, the pair travel to West Cornwall in search of Cornish Choughs, waders and transatlantic visitors blown hundreds of miles off course; to North Norfolk, on a wild goose chase for Brent and Pink-footed geese; and finally, to the Somerset Levels, where they stake out Kingfishers, Egrets and the elusive Bittern.   

Featuring exquisite photography and breathtaking landscapes, the series is as much about friendship as it is about wildlife. Between sightings, Sam and Ade share thoughtful, funny, and moving conversations on everything from obsession and ageing to acting, childhood memories, losing a parent and the geeky hobbies that have captivated them over the years.

name: AKA
summary: AKA doesn't listen to any advice. Aka doesn't follow any rules. He's coming to bring justice to the country with the power of a hammer.

name: The Vindication of Shadows
summary: Ten years ago, the Su family was wrongfully annihilated in a witchcraft scandal, leaving their eldest daughter, Su Zhaoxue, as the sole survivor. Determined to find her missing younger sister and uncover the truth, she disguises herself as a man and ventures into the capital. By a twist of fate, she joins forces with Fang Ji, an imperial censor also entangled in the case, and the two set out to Jinzhou under the guise of imperial envoys to investigate. As they peel back layers of deception, they uncover a conspiracy in which local officials exploit accusations of witchcraft to traffic illegal salt—leading them closer to the long-buried truth behind the Su family's downfall. As the investigation deepens, the true mastermind emerges: the Imperial Preceptor, whose ambitions threaten the very foundation of imperial power. Facing life-and-death trials, Su Zhaoxue and Fang Ji ultimately expose the shocking truth before the imperial court, clearing the name of her family and bringing justice to countless wronged souls. Having fulfilled their mission, the two choose to retreat from public life together.

name: Que no surti d'aquí: Al descobert
summary: A docuseries about the three protagonists of the radio show, beyond the microphones. What do Juliana Canet, Roger Carandell, and Marta Montaner talk about over breakfast? Why do they argue? What ethical dilemmas do they face? What is success to them? Do they really want to be as famous as the celebrities they talk about every day? In these seven specials, one every other Sunday, we join them on a journey full of adventures, flashbacks, gossip, VIP parties, and a television set.

previousepisode.name: Sortim amb les perfectes. Amb Laura Escanes i Jessica Goicoechea

name: My Lord, Do You Yield?
summary: The orphaned daughter of a distinguished military family, Song Xuan, is suddenly ordered by the emperor into a political marriage—with Bai Manchuan, a notorious playboy of the capital. Bai Manchuan initially vows to refuse, but with his marquis household facing financial ruin, he is forced to accept. On their wedding night, Song Xuan lays down strict household rules, demanding that Bai abandon his reckless ways and devote himself to study. Reluctantly, he embarks on a path of learning. Under her firm guidance and steady companionship, Bai Manchuan gradually sheds his frivolity and begins to mature. However, as the emperor falls gravely ill, the court descends into turmoil. Chancellor Shen conspires with nomadic tribes to usurp the throne, framing the Bai family in the process. Shen Lingbo, the chancellor's daughter—once indebted to Bai Manchuan and secretly in love with him—spirals into obsession after being rejected, ultimately becoming the mastermind behind the scheme. When a coup erupts, the Bai family risks everything to protect the throne, nearly perishing in the chaos. At the brink of death, Song Xuan miraculously returns and fights alongside Bai Manchuan to quell the rebellion. With no way out, Shen Lingbo takes her own life. Having endured trials of life and death, Bai Manchuan and Song Xuan emerge deeply devoted to one another, finally achieving their hard-earned happiness. With a smile, Song Xuan playfully asks the question that once defined their relationship: "So, my lord—do you finally yield?"

name: Затмение
summary: Moscow, 1960. Doctors are reporting an outbreak of smallpox in the capital, a deadly and incurable disease that was believed to have been eradicated in the USSR. The KGB assigns Colonel Shilov, for whom smallpox is more than just a diagnosis, to combat the epidemic. The hero must locate all the infected individuals and stop the spread of the virus at any cost, even if it means delving into the criminal underworld and exposing its dangerous inhabitants.

name: Крутые повороты
summary:
После праздничного корпоратива за директором крупной ремонтной компании Еленой Абрамовой начинает ухлестывать ее зам Анатолий Живенко. Сердце одинокой Елены дрогнуло, и она решила присмотреться к ухажеру. Отношения кажутся многообещающими, пока в офис не врывается разъяренный клиент Семён, который требует дать адрес квартиры, где его жена с любовником только что заказали ремонт. Затевается драка, и, к удивлению Елены, Живенко не полез вступаться за нее, а вызвал полицию, стоя в сторонке.

Попытка Елены наладить личную жизнь вскоре становится невыполнимой. Ее сын насмерть сбивает женщину, и выясняется, что это — жена районного прокурора. Суд приговаривает юношу к пяти годам заключения. Убитая горем, Елена возвращается ночью с зоны домой, и посреди пустой дороги у ее машины глохнет мотор. Неожиданно из темноты появляется старый джип. За рулем — тот самый «неадекватный хам» Семён, пьяный, да еще и с ружьем. Напуганная, Елена мысленно прощается с жизнью.

name: Сердечная аномалия
summary: Талантливый кардиохирург Марина в одночасье теряет все: будущего ребенка, обожаемого отца, жениха-предателя, любимую работу, веру в себя и людей. Спасение приходит с неожиданной стороны: в лице многолетней любовницы отца Ольги и ее младшего брата Артёма, которых Марина ошибочно считает врагами и виновниками своих бед.

name: Счастье с доставкой
summary: Семейная жизнь преподавателя колледжа Екатерины рушится, когда в город возвращается её школьная подруга Зоя. Муж Михаил чарован Зоей, он уходит из семьи, а Катя в одиночку вынуждена выплачивать его кредит. Из-за навязчивых ухаживаний директора колледжа Екатерина теряет работу. Её дочь Маша устраивается официанткой в ночной клуб, влюбляется в бармена и вскоре узнаёт, что беременна. Но отец отказывается от ребёнка и просит девушку сделать аборт. Чтобы обеспечить семью, Екатерина начинает работать репетитором. Так она знакомится с владельцем ресторана «Счастье с доставкой» Сергеем Завьяловым. Екатерина сочувствует отцу-одиночке, и между ними возникают чувства. Однако завистливая Зоя твёрдо намерена разрушить жизнь Екатерины и Сергея.

name: Я найду тебя через года
summary:
После автокатастрофы, в которой погибают все дети, учительница музыки Маша теряет свою дочь Алису. Но тело девочки так и не находят. Не в силах смириться с потерей, Маша меняет прежнюю жизнь: разводится с мужем Олегом, оставляет работу и замыкается в себе. Восемь лет спустя выясняется невероятное — Алиса жива. После аварии девочку подобрала бездетная пара. Теперь, когда приемная мать умирает, Алиса возвращается к Маше уже подростком и талантливой пианисткой.

Но за эти годы все изменились: Маша потеряла способность слышать музыку, а ее бывший муж Олег с новой семьей готов на все, чтобы заполучить дочь. В их жизни появляется Федор — преподаватель фортепиано, который помогает Алисе готовиться к поступлению в Консерваторию. Между ним и Машей зарождаются чувства. Тем временем Олег не намерен сдаваться без боя. Когда борьба за дочь переходит все границы, Маше придется сделать выбор между собственным счастьем и материнской любовью.

summary: Gulliver's Travels features Dr. Lemuel Gulliver washing ashore in Lilliput and attempting to prevent a war between Lilliput and Blefuscu. It was a children's adaptation featuring voice work from artists such as Sonja Ball and Daniel Brochu.

name: Rutte
summary: Mark Rutte is followed during his final months as prime minister of The Netherlands. He reflects on more than 13 years of leadership and offers a rare glimpse behind the scenes. What do his packed days look like? How does he make decisions? And what drives him? There are also interviews with (former) politicians and friends.

name: Acda en De Munnik: Woorden van een ander
summary: Acda and De Munnik shows how Thomas and Paul met at the Kleinkunstacademie to their last performance in Carré. And we see their reunion develop, from writing together again for the first time on Ameland, to the start of six sold-out shows in Ziggo Dome.

name: Ruud Gullit and the Mysteries of Ancient Egypt
summary: Former Dutch professional football player Ruud Gullit goes on an adventure, exploring a bond with ancient Egypt he has felt for most of his life. He meets a range of experts and fellow enthusiasts for a deep dive in both legends and science.

name: All But Divorced
summary: After more than 7 years of marriage, Yara who works as a chemistry teacher in an international school, suspects that Sief, her husband, who works as a freelance writer is cheating on her. By the time she uncovers the truth, unexpected things take place, and their lives becomes threatened and turns upside down.

name: Feel what you feel
summary: Ming De University law students Yu Lei and Chen Ke have no idea that they'll change each other's lives when they first meet. Initially, they seem like complete opposites: Yu Lei is bold and confident, while Chen Ke leans quieter, preferring to distance himself from others in a group. But instead, Yu Lei is caught off-guard by Chen Ke, leaving him without his usual bravado. Throughout their years of school, Yu Lei and Chen Ke gradually develop feelings for each other, but keep it hidden – until an impromptu game of football with the men's dormitory brings unspoken emotions out into the open.

name: Cat for honeymoon
summary: Tiger and Lynx's honeymoon trip goes off-plan and they wind up sleeping in a tent outside their homestay after Tiger says there's something mysterious inside. So, Lynx takes Tiger back inside the house to prove exactly what the source of that sound is.

name: Murder on the Fringe
summary: Takes viewers on a journey into some of the most riveting homicide stories of the 21st century committed in society's most marginalized communities.

name: Pls.Love
summary:
Based on a novel by Reverse, the story promises rivalry, emotional tension, and an unexpected connection between two women from very different worlds. The narrative follows two women whose lives exist in very different worlds. Fah is recognized as the top employee of a lounge club. Used to navigating complicated situations, she receives a task involving a wealthy businesswoman who openly despises her. That woman is Phakinee. Circumstances unexpectedly place them in the same bed, creating the starting point for a relationship built on confrontation, curiosity and growing emotional tension. As they continue to encounter each other, their initial hostility slowly shifts into something more complicated.

Beyond the attraction that develops between them, the story explores the insecurities created by social differences. Through this conflict, the series reflects on vulnerability, pride and the meaning of love between two people who never expected to connect.

name: Amar Vishwas
summary: Brilliant, eccentric Mumbai lawyer Amar Vishwas defends the underprivileged while seeking hidden truths. When a powerful businessman is murdered, he navigates a deadly web of lies, suspects, and shocking twists to deliver justice.

name: Русские цари
summary: A documentary about the Romanov dynasty. "Tsar" was the primary title of the monarchs of the Russian Empire beginning in 1547. Officially, Ivan IV the Terrible was the first tsar, and Peter I was the last. After Peter I, the title of Russian monarchs became "emperor." However, as a semi-official title, it remained with Russian monarchs until the 1917 Revolution.

name: Lenny und Twiek
summary: Lenny is looking for a friend. To this end, he puts up a "wanted" ad on a big tree, but no one responds. Instead, Lenny stumbles upon Twiek, who's dragging his birdhouse behind him. Well, until a friend comes along, Lenny can at least pass the time with Twiek…

name: Rasmus Klump
summary: The whole world is their playground, but they are always back home in time for pancakes.

name: Mamonogurai no Boukensha: Ore dake Mamono wo Kuratte Tsuyoku Naru
summary: Rudd's a nobody-- just an E-Rank adventurer with a seemingly useless talent of status immunity. An outcast in a city obsessed with labyrinth crawling, he's stuck scraping by as a "grubby forager," navigating guild politics and backstabbing adventurers just to survive. But when a betrayal leaves him for dead without any supplies or help, he does the unthinkable and consumes the flesh of fallen monsters...

name: Kujima: Why Sing, When You Can Warble?
summary: In the fall of his first year of middle school, Arata Kouda meets Kujima, a strange, talkative creature that's neither bird nor human. What begins as a small act of kindness turns into an unexpected stay at the Kouda household. Meant to be only until spring, Kujima's clumsy warmth, soft cries, and gentle mystery quietly become part of the family's days, weaving tender, fleeting bonds.

name: Clash of the Superpowers: America vs China
summary:
Clash of the Superpowers: America vs China delivers the inside story of how, since Donald Trump's first term as President, America and China have become locked in a battle for global power and influence.

Drawing on candid first-hand accounts from key insiders, the documentary looks at the policies, personalities, power plays, and pivotal moments that have shaped one of the most consequential geopolitical rivalries of our time.

name: Surviving the Cold General
summary: Transmigrated into a novel as a princess, Li Xunzhi knows her fate. One month from now, her husband Xiao Xing will execute her. Determined to survive, she takes the initiative to win his heart, navigating the schemes of a scheming cousin and the suspicions of those around them. Along the way, she outsmarts the crises plaguing the marquis's household and untangles the corruption in the estate's ledgers, earning Xiao Xing's respect with each triumph. Just as they finally find their way to each other, Xiao Xing is ensnared in a conspiracy woven by foreign spies.

name: In Love with Loving You
summary: At his darkest hour, Song Zhaoli crosses paths with Ji Xuan, a young woman shattered by family tragedy. In secret, he sponsors her education. Years later, a twist of fate brings Ji Xuan back into his life. Against all odds, Song Zhaoli rises from the ashes, breaking through every barrier in his path. Through continuous interaction and communication, the two gradually understand and respect each other, and their love heal each other.

name: Zero Stars
summary: Best friends and comedians Roisin Conaty and Sara Pascoe are visiting locations with the most hilarious, baffling and terribly bad reviews.

name: Decoding History's Prophecies
summary:
Revelations, fortunes and harbingers of doom … human history is scattered with mysterious people rumored to have supernatural insight into the future. Have forces beyond our understanding endowed these extraordinary individuals with the gift of prophecy, or is there a rational explanation for these visions?

This riveting documentary series blends dramatic reenactments, sweeping footage, and interviews with a panel of experts to present three captivating stories per episode. From ancient China to medieval Europe and modern-day West Virginia, some cases turn out to be elaborate deceptions, others remain eerily unexplained, and all reveal a perpetual human desire to see beyond the veil of time — with reverberating effects on history.

name: Disaster Strike Force
summary: Leading geoscientist Dr. Molly Martin sees Earth at a tipping point as climate change fuels natural disasters. Rather than wait for bureaucracy, she and her family join international disaster response unit R.E.A.C.T.

name: Ready or Not: Texas
summary: No plans, just vibes. When two best friends and their crew set off for Texas on an entirely unscripted adventure, there's no telling what's coming next.

name: Антикиллер 2: Антитеррор

name: Tom Scott: England
summary: Tom Scott takes a road trip to every county of England, travelling by car, train, boat, plane, tram, monorail and hovercraft, visiting hidden infrastructure, ancient traditions, and more bells than you might expect.
